summary: The registrant, Generation Income Properties, Inc., filed an 8-K reporting the entry into the Seventh Amendment to its partnership agreement, modifying terms of Series A Redeemable Preferred Units held by JCWC Funding, LLC. The amendment adjusts redemption price mechanics, introduces extension periods, and updates protective provisions. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved. The filing is a routine contract amendment with no broader strategic event.
